system.description:
Battle Amp

You have found inner peace. You want for nothing, except the humiliation of your foes. When you enter Nirvana, select 3 of the listed effects. You gain the 3 chosen effects for the duration.

Recycling Chi. At the beginning of each of your turns, and once per turn when you cast a Jutsu with the Combo or Chain keyword, you regain 1 Inner Chi.

Without Effort. You gain a rank of Mastery to your AC until the end of your next turn, each time you cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component.

Chi Guard. When you take damage, once per turn you can spend your reaction to spend up your remaining Inner Chi, to reduce the triggering damage by 4, for each chi spent.

Obstacle Avoidance. When you succeed a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs a hostile effect, you suffer no damage or additional effects.

Master of Transfiguration. You can access all Simple and Partial Transformations found under the Inner Chi and Advanced Transformations clan feature.

Pure Heart. When you fail a saving throw against a Constitution, Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, you can spend 1 Inner Chi to remake the failed saving throw. If you fail again, you can spend an additional 2 Inner Chi to remake the saving throw again, increasing the Inner Chi spent by +1 for each use before the beginning of your next turn.
system.summary: Pick 3 of its 6 benefits when you enter. Inner Chi recovery, AC Mastery, chi damage reduction, save protection, every transformation, or save rerolls.

rules.text: Start: at the beginning of your turn, spend 4 Inner Chi (once per long rest).
Choose the 3 effects when you enter; they're played at the table.
